About Founded in 1833, Oberlin is a private four-year, highly selective national liberal arts college that is also home to an outstanding Conservatory of Music. Together, the two divisions enroll approximately 2900 students. Faculty in the department have their own individual research labs, receive competitive startup packages, and are expected to work closely with undergraduate students on original research projects. Responsibilities The incumbent will teach the standard teaching load (4.5 courses per year) in the general area of conservation ecology with a preference for vertebrate study systems.
